subject.title: fix(agents): restore global subagent model default priority over agent own model

question: Should agents.defaults.subagents.model override a named agent's own primary model in every subagent path, including isolated cron and fallback policy?
rationale: Current main contains conflicting merged contracts: native spawn uses global-default-first, while the shared cron/fallback selector uses agent-primary-first, and either consolidation changes existing users' routing.

options.title: Global subagent default wins
options.body: Align the shared helper with current native spawn behavior and the documented subagent default contract.

options.title: Named-agent primary wins
options.body: Keep the shared helper order and separately revise native spawn behavior and documentation so agent-primary precedence is consistent everywhere.

recommendation.title: Global subagent default wins
recommendation.body: Align the shared helper with current native spawn behavior and the documented subagent default contract.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the shared cron/fallback selector refactor and is the strongest history-backed owner for deciding its compatibility contract.
